reviews.comment: Professsor Deere really cares about the class and his lectures are really well-done. He has a lot of reading and essays which are enjoyable, even if I didn't agree with the majority of the subjects being debated I found it informative. Our class was small and friendly and Professor Deere is funny so it's a good combination. 100% recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: While I don't enjoy Philosophy and I only took the class for Core Curriculum, Professor Deere always made sure to explain everything he taught in a simplified way and was always answered questions.  PHIL251 wasn't completely stress free, but there was little homework and the exams were very similar to the quizzes and reviews which helped a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's an alright lecturer but the weekly assigned readings are lengthy and the weekly quizzes can draw specifics from those readings. Doesn't do much to make the topic interesting but put in the effort(and quite a bit of time) and you'd get an A.

super nice guy and funny! he really cared about students and helped a lot on test feedback, take him if you can!
Weekly quiz, a presentation, and 2 exams. Super easy class, just put in effort!

He is super chill and funny.  Quizzes every week but they are easy.  Just read the material and you will do well.  Course was two exams, weekly quizzes, a project, and discussion posts.  An "A" is super attainable if you are half decent at writing for the short answer portion of the exams.

Weekly Quizzes that are MCQ, 10 question each. I never got a 100, and never below a 70.
Project grade is easy in theory, but the highest grade in the class was a 96. I got a 95.

This professor believes that an A is for students who go above and beyond, while a B is for a student that does everything they should.

Easy B. VERY HARD A.

Nice and very caring professor. Weekly one page papers which were very doable and simple to accomplish. Lectures are interesting and useful for notes for the papers. I would recommend this class. A good amount of group activities so get ready to socialize. Besides that, good professor, interesting coursework, and no exams, only papers due.
